theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1ab_uniform_taylor_remainder
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ C : Set (Rn n), IsClosed C → volume C ≠ ∞ → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → ∀ δ : ℝ≥0∞, δ ≠ 0 → ∃ A : Set (Rn n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < δ ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖f y - f x - fderiv ℝ f x (y - x)‖ ≤ τ * ‖y - x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
